custom_logic_notes: This is a multi-currency ring/arbitrage EA. It constructs combinations of 3 currencies from user-specified list (3-8 currencies, e.g. EUR/GBP/USD), forming C(n,3) ring groups. Each group has 3 pairs forming a 'ring' (e.g. EURUSD, EURGBP, GBPUSD). Two suites per group: Plus (BUY/SELL/BUY) and Minus (SELL/BUY/SELL). The ring profit arises from the net spread/differential. Grid-like scaling: when existing ring position is in loss, new orders can be opened at a step distance (manual, auto, or no-loss mode). Step and lot progressions support static, geometric, and exponential growth. Close logic supports single-ticket or basket (all 3 legs together) closing. Session control limits trading around Monday open and Friday close. Spread filter checks MaxSpread per group before opening. The EA uses timer-based execution (default 1000ms) rather than tick-driven, enabling multi-symbol monitoring from a single chart.
python_conversion_notes: Extremely complex to convert. The core logic is multi-symbol ring arbitrage requiring simultaneous management of up to 56 groups x 2 directions x 3 pairs = 336 position legs. Grid/martingale progression makes backtesting tick-essential. The ring profit model depends on real-time bid prices across multiple symbols which requires a multi-symbol data feed. Position management (open/close/delay counters) is tracked via per-group arrays with complex state. Session control, spread filtering, margin checks, and order limit checks are all interdependent. Would need a full portfolio-level backtesting framework in Python, not a simple single-symbol converter.
